cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward integration into component manufacture: in addition to site-based contracting services, the Company operates an in-house manufacturing facility (Mettukuppam, Chennai, 5000 Sq Ft) engaged in the fabrication of customised furniture, joinery and fit-out components, and concurrently undertakes Cushion and Upholstery Work for seating and soft-furnishing components. The DRHP states this in-house manufacturing capability enables the Company to exercise direct quality control over finished components, optimise production timelines and deliver customised fit-out elements aligned with the specific design and functional requirements of each project. Inputs are sourced through a structured procurement process from a network of pre-approved manufacturers, suppliers and vendors, with multiple quotations obtained and evaluated on technical specifications, pricing, delivery timelines and vendor reliability, and quality checks and inspections on delivery; plywood is procured from approved suppliers against specified thickness, grade (e.g. MR or BWR) and dimensions, and is then processed in-house through laminate/veneer pasting, cutting and sizing, edge banding, upholstery and assembly before handover to the client. Downstream, the Company both contracts directly with clients and executes work on a sub-contracting basis (Rs. 1,640.50 lakhs, 38.25% of revenue from operations for the period ended February 28, 2026), and engages multiple vendors and contractors for specialized work. State-wise raw material procurement for the period ended February 28, 2026 totalled Rs. 3,096.92 lakhs, of which Tamil Nadu was 72.77%, Telangana 15.05%, Karnataka 3.25%, Kerala 3.15%, Odisha 2.39% and Maharashtra 2.12%.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- Proficient workforce with specialized expertise in interior fit-outs, enabling execution of complex and customized projects to design specification while maintaining quality standards and project timelines.
- Stated growth in financial performance: revenue from operations rose from Rs. 1,861.62 lakhs in Fiscal 2023 to Rs. 4,289.31 lakhs in the eleven months ended February 28, 2026, and profit after tax from Rs. 68.03 lakhs to Rs. 753.31 lakhs over the same span.
- ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system, with a quality approach spanning the early design phase through the project …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Top five clients accounted for 59.29% of revenue in the period ended February 28, 2026, 86.91% in Fiscal 2025, 92.64% in Fiscal 2024 and 84.67% in Fiscal 2023; the top ten were 82.06%, 99.25%, 98.86% and 98.13% respectively, so revenue rests on a small number of relationships.
- Operations have been primarily concentrated in Tamil Nadu since incorporation in 2014; Tamil Nadu contributed 96.45% of revenue in Fiscal 2025 and 95.68% in Fiscal 2024, exposing the Company to state-specific demand, regulatory and project risk.
- The DRHP states the Order Book of 12 ongoing projects worth Rs. 4,226.72 lakhs as of February 28, 2026 may not be representative of future results and that actual income may vary from the estimates reflected in it.
- Projects are executed on the basis of work orders or agreements issued by clients; no committed long-term volume is disclosed, so revenue depends on continued order inflow.
- MD&A states revenues are largely driven by the size, composition and execution timeline of the order book and that delays in project commencement, client approvals or execution milestones can defer revenue.
- Revenue earned as sub-contractor was 38.25% of revenue in the period ended February 28, 2026 and 52.52% in Fiscal 2025, placing a material share of income behind principal contractors rather than direct client relationships.
- Funding incremental working capital requirements is one of the stated Objects of the Fresh Issue, indicating the project execution model absorbs working capital as scale increases.
- Managing Director Mugundhan Sekar has been associated with the Company since inception and is credited with establishing its operational framework and overseeing day-to-day execution; the leadership team is itself listed as a key strength, concentrating execution knowledge.

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Set up a new manufacturing facility measuring 9,266 sq.ft. at Periyapanichery Village, Kundrathur Taluk, Kancheepuram district, Tamil Nadu, funded from the Net Proceeds of the Fresh Issue.**
- **Apply part of the Net Proceeds of the Fresh Issue towards funding incremental working capital requirements.**
- **Full or part repayment and/or prepayment of certain outstanding unsecured borrowings availed by the Company, out of the Net Proceeds.**
- **Apply a portion of the Net Proceeds of the Fresh Issue towards general corporate purposes.**
- **Execute the Order Book of 12 ongoing projects carrying an aggregate contract value of Rs. 4,226.72 lakhs as of February 28, 2026.**
- **Expand the geographical footprint beyond Tamil Nadu by gradually increasing the project portfolio across multiple States in India, broadening the revenue base and reducing over-reliance on any single region.**
- **Expand project scale by improving project management systems, resource planning and execution efficiency so as to bid for and execute larger, more complex and higher-value interior fit-out projects.**
- **Pursue a client-centric approach, delivering customised interior and fit-out solutions to client-specific requirements within stipulated timelines while incorporating current design concepts, materials and technologies.**
- **Continue to enhance core strengths by attracting and retaining personnel (strategy heading stated in the DRHP; the supporting text is truncated in the extracted section).**
